description: Filter on the CMOS design, which uses a digital inverter chip in place of operational amplifiers, giving a distorted and aggressive character, with lowpass, bandpass, highpass and notch outputs

params.text: Sets the frequency at which the filter starts to act: fully counter-clockwise it is closed, fully clockwise it is open
Boosts the frequencies near the cutoff, and this filter does not self-oscillate
Sets how much signal enters the filter, and raising it saturates the filter and adds harmonics
Distorts the output of the filter, which returns harmonics the filter has taken out
Attenuates and inverts the CUT input before it is added to the cutoff, and a 1V/octave signal through it makes the cutoff track pitch
Attenuates and inverts the RES input before it is added to the resonance
Attenuates and inverts the DRIVE input before it is added to the drive
Attenuates and inverts the bite modulation input before it is added to the BITE knob

inputs.text: The audio input to the filter
A control voltage added to the cutoff, scaled by the CUT attenuverter, and tracking 1V per octave when that attenuverter is set for it
A control voltage added to the resonance, scaled by the RES attenuverter
A control voltage added to the drive, scaled by the DRIVE attenuverter
A control voltage added to the bite, scaled by the bite attenuverter
